name: usage-pace
description: Adds a pace indicator for your 5h and 7d usage to your existing status line, and can tint the session color to match.

sessionColor.title: Session color by pace
sessionColor.description: Which window sets the session color (green, yellow or red): 5h, 7d, or worse (whichever is further over pace). Off leaves the color alone.

aheadIsPositive.title: Show under pace as positive
aheadIsPositive.description: By default, using less than the time elapsed shows as negative (-12). Turn on to show it as +12.

threshold.title: On-pace margin (±)
threshold.description: How many points from pace still count as on pace (yellow). At 5, anything from -5 to +5 is yellow.

showCountdown.title: Show 5h reset countdown
showCountdown.description: Append how long until the 5-hour window resets.
